pages.title: Gray Wolf
pages.text: The gray wolf ($(o)Canis lupus$()) is a canid native to the wilderness of Eurasia and North America, from Arctic tundra to forests and deserts.$(br2)It is the largest wild member of the dog family. Most wolves live in packs made up of a breeding pair and their offspring, which hunt large prey together.$(br2)The domestic dog descends from an ancient population of wolves.
